question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant encountered when moving toward Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry, Muncie, IN from Daubenspeck Nature Reserve, Indianapolis, IN?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Daubenspeck Nature Reserve%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Indianapolis%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), end_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Muncie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_path AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(sl.geometry, el.geometry) AS geom FROM start_location sl, end_location el ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, travel_path tp WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, tp.geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
